blocks.text: SCHEDULE: UAAP Season 89 basketball tournament – second round MANILA, Philippines–Far Eastern University completed an elimination-round sweep University of the Philippines with a 71-68 win on Saturday that strengthened its Final Four bid in the UAAP Season 89 men’s basketball tournament on Saturday at Smart Araneta Coliseum. The Tamaraws held UP to just 27 points in the second half to snap the Fighting Maroons’ seven-game winning streak and improve to 7-5, good for solo third place ahead of idle La Salle (6-5).
